verdict.rationale: Claude Design markets turning mockups into 'shareable, interactive prototypes you can test with real people' (claude-design-docs-1) and offers layout/adjustment controls (claude-design-docs-9), but there is no evidence of the specific no-code prototyping mechanics described in the story — defining triggers, transitions between screens, or overlay states as in tools like Figma. Community feedback focuses on generation quality and code handoff, not interactive prototyping mechanics. Missing for 10: explicit trigger/transition/overlay wiring UI, evidence of multi-screen click-through flows, and independent confirmation of this specific workflow.
